contract: docs/zwf/2026-11-05-管理端UI复刻方案.md; scope: management shell and activities, existing loaded-list API only

accessibility.evidence: Native dialogs support Escape, focus trap and restore; labelled form fields; visible focus; green/white and text contrast checked; reduced-motion has no decorative animation. Icon-only close controls labelled.

responsive.evidence: DOM overflow assertions on screen body and every activity card at all four target viewports, including long source/title. Navigation and status filters deliberately scroll internally.

loading.evidence: Delayed list response renders stable loading text.

empty.evidence: Empty data and zero filtered results have distinct recovery actions.

error.evidence: 503 list and PATCH failures exercised; retry works and draft retained.

partial.evidence: Place API fails independently; list stays usable and filter exposes retry.

success.evidence: Mock POST/PATCH updates verified, success notices and authoritative list reload.

permission.evidence: Student sees denied state; asserted no admin API requests.

renderedEvidence.observation: Long Chinese/English titles and long source fit; horizontally scrollable navigation/status row remains within screen; real fixture times and years visible.
